title: Coleman Brands Pty Ltd - completed acquisition of Nylex Ltd Group's Esky hard and soft cooler business
targets: Nylex Ltd Group's Esky hard and soft cooler business

timeline.event: ACCC noted press reports indicating that Coleman Brands Pty Ltd had acquired Nylex Ltd Group's Esky hard and soft cooler business. ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the completed acquisition in the context of national markets for the manufacture and supply of hard and soft coolers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the completed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets given the presence of alternative suppliers of hard and soft coolers in Australia which are likely to constrain the merged firm.
